criteria.text: Brand name multi-source medication coverage request (DAW) with an A-rated generic equivalent in the Orange Book.

Recipient has tried the generic version at the same dose and interval requested from at least two different manufacturers, with a documented adverse drug reaction or therapeutic failure with each product.

Documentation of each adverse drug reaction or treatment failure, including a copy of the completed FDA MedWatch form, has been submitted with a letter of medical necessity from the prescriber detailing the need for the brand name version.

notes: Partial encoding of Alaska Medicaid DAW / brand-over-generic policy for brand name multi-source medications with A-rated generic equivalents. Both approval conditions are required; submitted documentation requires manual review.
Excluded medications (notes only): Digoxin, Levothyroxine, Phenytoin, and Warfarin are excluded from the criteria above.
Reference: Approved Drug Products with Therapeutic Equivalence Evaluations (Orange Book), http://www.accessdata.fda.gov/scripts/cder/ob/default.cfm.
DAW Criteria Version 1; Approved 1/21/2011; Last updated 6/8/2012. Rules engine is the sole eligibility evaluator.
